chunks: To those who deny the signs of God, and slay the apostles unjustly, and slay the upholders of justice, give news of painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three groups mentioned in the Quran who receive painful punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as highlighting the triad of rejection: disbelief in divine signs, the unjust killing of prophets, and the murder of those who enjoin justice, with the latter group frequently understood to include the Imams who guide the community. The 'painful punishment' serves as a warning to those who oppose the divinely appointed leaders of justice throughout history. This verse underscores the continuity of prophetic mission and the specific role of the Ahl al-Bayt in commanding justice.
